title: Monotonicity inequalities and unit density lower bound for bounded mean curvature
statement: Let n ≥ 1, k ≥ 0, U ⊆ ℝ^{n+k} any set, R = (M, θ, ξ) an integer multiplicity triple in U (IMRep U n) with μ := R.measure = θHⁿ⌞M (Hⁿ = μHE[n]), W ⊆ U open, κ ∈ ℝ, H : ℝ^{n+k} → ℝ^{n+k} μ-a.e. strongly measurable with |H(x)| ≤ κ for all x, such that R.firstVariation X = −∫⟨X, H⟩dμ for every C¹ compactly supported X : ℝ^{n+k} → ℝ^{n+k} with tsupport X ⊆ W. For y ∈ ℝ^{n+k} let F_y(x) := |p_x^⊥(x − y)|²/|x − y|^{n+2} (0 at x = y). Then (1) for every y and 0 < s < t with B_t(y) ⊆ W: (M1) ∫_{B_t(y)∖B_s(y)} F_y dμ + e^{κs}s^{−n}μ(B_s(y)) ≤ e^{κt}t^{−n}μ(B_t(y)) and (M2) e^{−κt}t^{−n}μ(B_t(y)) ≤ e^{−κs}s^{−n}μ(B_s(y)) + ∫_{B_t(y)∖B_s(y)} F_y dμ; and (2) for every y ∈ spt μ and t > 0 with B_t(y) ⊆ W: (D) ∫_{B_t(y)} F_y dμ + ω_n ≤ e^{κt}t^{−n}μ(B_t(y)), where ω_n = unitBallVolume n. Here p_x is the orthogonal projection onto approxTangentPlane n M x, p_x^⊥ := I − p_x, p_S the orthogonal projection onto a subspace S, |A|² := Σ_i |Ae_i|² the Hilbert–Schmidt norm (the Lean sum over EuclideanSpace.single i 1), B_t(y) the closed ball, and integrals of nonnegative functions are lower Lebesgue integrals in [0, ∞] (Lean ∫⁻ of ENNReal.ofReal).
